name: Hexing Effigy renders at its summon model scale (#7793)
contract: The CoA alpha creature cache (coa-datamine-master, raw/cache/enus/creaturecache) records entry 50120 'Hexing
Effigy' with display 412985 and scale 0.2, while its siblings Swift Idol 50118 and Shadow Effigy 50119 carry 1.0.
The cache's scale field is the classic creature scale: the same field holds 0.98 for Murloc Forager, 3.3792 for
Blue Dragonspawn and 0.0106 for Map Trigger. Display 412985 is the world doodad
8tr_ancientblood_headstatue01.m2, which the client draws at world size, so the installed DisplayScale 1 renders the
gigantic effigy of the report. creature_template_model.DisplayScale is the creature's model scale
(ObjectMgr loads it into CreatureTemplate::CreatureDisplayData and Creature::SetDisplayId applies it), and
owned_creature_scale reads the resulting ObjectScale. The captured 0.2 still renders a statue that towers over the
player, so the summon is deliberately stepped down to 0.07, the size the class's other stationary totems occupy.
Expected: the summoned Hexing Effigy renders at 0.07 and a second Witch Doctor's Shadow Effigy keeps the captured
1.0. Client rendering itself is not observed.

steps.label: SETUP: the Hexing Effigy is known
SETUP: the Shadow Effigy is known
Enter combat so the effigy may be placed
SETUP: the Hexing Effigy is summoned
SETUP: it uses the captured doodad display
CONTRACT: the Hexing Effigy renders at the summon scale 0.07
Enter combat so the effigy may be placed
SETUP: the Shadow Effigy is summoned
REGRESSION: the sibling keeps the captured 1.0 scale
